# Test fixtures

Small sample notes, one folder per scenario. Each folder is used by the test
cases listed in `modules/*/test_cases.md`.

| Folder | Used by | Added in |
|---|---|---|
| `reader/` | TC-RDR-* | Milestone 3 |
| `extractor/` | TC-EXT-* | Milestone 3 |
| `dedupe/` (N1, N2, N3) | TC-DUP-* | Milestone 5 |
| `mix/` | TC-REP-* | Milestone 8 |

Rules:

- Keep notes tiny: just enough lines to show the scenario.
- No real names or email addresses. Use the people from the requirements
  (Priya Shah, Priya Kumar, Rahul Mehta, Anita Rao).
- Files with bad encodings or random bytes are **generated by the tests**
  (in `tmp_path`), not committed, so editors cannot "fix" them.

## Note formats (milestone 1)

No sample `notes/` folder was provided. Per `decisions.md` (Q1, QA-5) the
supported header formats are:

```markdown
Date: 2026-10-06
Attendees: Priya Shah, Rahul Mehta, Anita Rao
```

Labels may use any case, bold (`**Date:**`) and extra spaces. When real
samples arrive, record the formats found here and add fixtures for them.
